notes: Optima Care / Essential Care riders: pairs_with and entry_age left out. The Enhanced IncomeShield brochure says the riders attach to the Enhanced Preferred or Enhanced Advantage plan, but the riders conditions also carry Enhanced Basic columns, and the rider-specific last entry age 75 is not on any allowed rider source (the 75 in the brochure is the main plan).

Complete Critical Protect: claims cell covers Protect Max (up to 10x, multiple claims) and Protect Prime (up to 3x); Protect 100 allows only 1 claim (up to 1x). Waiting cell covers the 90-day clauses only; other benefits have their own survival and waiting rules. Entry age not found in the brochure or policy conditions, so left out.

DIRECT Star Term: renewable (TAN17, 5-year terms renewing to age 84, entry 18 to 64) and non-renewable (TAN18, 20 years or to age 64) differ; term and entry_age cells describe the non-renewable version, the others are labelled.

Family Protect: entry age and a premium-guarantee statement for the term not stated in the brochure; the premium cell comes from the policy conditions. Renewal needs no claim and the insured aged 64 (last birthday) or below.
Mortgage Term: no entry age, premium or renewal statements on its brochure or conditions, so those cells are left out.

Lady 360: TPD and terminal illness are not stated as benefits (female illnesses, surgeries, support benefits and a S$10,000 death benefit), so left out rather than marked No. Entry age is not in the brochure.
TermLife Solitaire: TPD is only through the Disability Accelerator rider. Premium guarantee not stated.

HomeTeamNS, SAFRA and OCBC Protect each combine two products or covers; cells name the variant. OCBC cells come from the Classic summary; Prime shows the same TPD and terminal illness rows. LUV terminal illness is part of the Deluxe cover only.
Star Term Protect brochure is dated 20 Aug 2024; the policy conditions (TAN19, 202510) were used for TPD and terminal illness.
